profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Zscaler | Python, Golang, Java, Kubernetes, and Web development
profile.summary:
With over 10 years of experience in software engineering, I am passionate about building scalable, reliable, and secure web applications and REST APIs. As a senior software engineer at Runscope, I applied my expertise in Python, Golang, AWS, Google cloud, and Kubernetes to lead the development team, deliver high-quality features, and solve complex technical challenges.

At Runscope, I was involved in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and deployment. I led the dev team to release features such as real-time test concurrency limit warning. I also diagnosed and fixed the root cause of high CPU consumption in Golang applications, resolved various SSL/TLS issues raised by enterprise customers. Additionally, I earned two patents for validation of containers, and acquired two certifications: CKAD and OCPJP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and developed an autonomous API testing system with Pytest for validating API contracts, measuring API performance and identifying the cause of high latency:
  - Led to a 31% reduction in API response times for large file uploads.
  - Implemented a method for automatic test case generation, significantly broadening test coverage.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Druid · Python · Kubernetes · Java · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Runscope was acquired by multiple companies: CA Technologies, Broadcom, and Perforce Software. Runscope has become a part of BlazeMeter to offer holistic user experiences in monitoring web applications and REST APIs.

• Led the dev team to release the following features:
  - Real-time test concurrency limit warning in the dashboard.
  - Enhanced APIs to list host details of the agents.
  - Email notifications for API monitoring tests to email distribution lists or non-member emails.
• Diagnosed and fixed the root cause of high CPU consumption in Golang applications.
• Resolved various SSL/TLS issues raised by enterprise customers.
• Ported all Python 2 code to Python 3 before Python 2 reached End of Life on January 1st, 2020.
• Migrated Runscope from Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) to Google Cloud Platform (GCP):
  - Containerized each microservice with Docker and deployed them to the Kubernetes cluster in GCP.
  - Implemented a new adapter to access MongoDB.
• Integrated Runscope with BlazeMeter:
  - Connected Runscope with the global identity provider to enable single sign-on.
  - Programmatically migrated BlazeMeter users to Runscope to provide a seamless experience using both services.
• Implemented fine-grained role-based access control for enterprise customers to offer greater control in granting access rights to different user roles.
• Implemented the secrets management feature allowing team admin users to manage sensitive variables, which are encrypted and hidden from all test results containing secrets.
• Enabled enterprise customers to integrate their API monitoring tests with DX Application Performance Management (formerly CA Application Performance Management or CA APM).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Qubeship 1.0
: a platform for the opinionated container lifecycle management delivering the enterprise-grade containerized applications
- designed and developed the Qubeship opinion engine that parses the input from users and runs a build accordingly (co-inventor of 2 patents. please take a look at the Patents section)
- designed and implemented the RESTful APIs of the services
- containerized each component of Qubeship and deployed them to Google cloud
- configured the Kubernetes cluster where Qubeship SaaS runs

Qubeship 2.0
: a service integration tool for microservices, automating tedious and time consuming tasks like containerization, code instrumentation and documentation, freeing developers to focus on coding.
- designed, implemented, and deployed the sandbox app to the cloud
- did researches on multiple services to be easily integrated with microservices
